x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: LLM-aware. Structured JSON output. No interactivity.

commands.name: info
commands.description: Show the database the application is connected to

commands.name: referenced-by
commands.description: List tables and columns that reference the given table

commands.name: resolve-action
commands.description: Resolve an action (page) route to its runtime contract: bound procedures, view/template, and model type tree.

arguments.name: ROUTE
arguments.description: Endpoint route: <path>/<action>, $prefix for a module (e.g. catalog/agent/index)

commands.name: resolve-dialog
commands.description: Resolve an dialog (model) route to its runtime contract: bound procedures, view/template, and model type tree.

arguments.name: ROUTE
arguments.description: Endpoint route: <path>/<dialog>, $prefix for a module (e.g. catalog/agent/edit)

commands.name: resolve-popup
commands.description: Resolve an action (popup) route to its runtime contract: bound procedures, view/template, and model type tree.

arguments.name: ROUTE
arguments.description: Endpoint route: <path>/<popup>, $prefix for a module (e.g. catalog/agent/balance)

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Validate a view file by loading and instantiating it as the server does: malformed markup, unknown elements or properties, bad enum values, missing includes. Bindings are not checked against the data model.

arguments.name: VIEW_FILE
arguments.description: View file, relative to the module root; $prefix for a module. Example: catalog/agent/index.view (.vxaml is appended if needed).
